catch.title: Add Catch
catch.subtitle: Log today's catch in 6 quick steps.

category.title: Choose the Catch Category
category.description: Choose the type that makes up most of your catch.
category.info: Several kinds in the catch? Choose Mixed. You can change the category before the listing goes up.
category.otherHelper: Enter the type that makes up most of your catch. This name appears on the listing.
category.otherError: Enter the catch type to continue.

volume.title: How Much Did You Catch?
volume.description: Enter an estimate of the catch's weight in kilograms (kg).
volume.error: Enter a weight of at least 1 kg.
volume.info: An estimate is fine, it doesn't have to be exact.

time.title: When Was This Catch Hauled?
time.description: Choose when the net was hauled. This helps estimate freshness.
time.error: Choose when the net was hauled to continue.

condition.title: What Condition Is the Catch In?
condition.description: Choose its condition as you log it. This decides grade A (live) or B (dead).
condition.error: Choose the catch's condition to continue.

ice.title: How Much Ice Is There?
ice.description: Choose what's closest to how the catch is kept right now.
ice.banyakDescription: The catch is covered in ice
ice.error: Choose the ice condition to continue.

photo.title: Catch Photo
photo.description: Shoot from above so the whole catch is visible. The photo is used to estimate the grade.
photo.webcamOffDescription: Turn on the webcam and point it at the catch from above, or choose Upload Photo.
photo.webcamDeniedDescription: Allow camera access in your browser settings, then try again. You can also choose Upload Photo.
photo.webcamLiveCaption: Point the webcam at the catch from above.
photo.uploadEmptyDescription: Choose a photo of the catch taken from above.
photo.error: Take or upload a photo to continue.
photo.savedOffline: Photo saved on this device. It's analysed automatically once the device is back online.
photo.analyzingDescription: Please wait a moment. Don't close this page.

hero.eyebrow: B2B PLATFORM FOR THE CIRCULAR OCEAN ECONOMY
hero.headline: Turning By-catch into Shared Economic Value
hero.subheadline: ByCatch Loop connects fishers with circular downstream industries through batch logging, fast auctions and lightweight AI freshness estimates.

nelayan.imageAlt: A fisher hauling a net from a boat in shallow water

income.title: Extra Income
income.description: From catch that used to be worth nothing or less.

noWaste.title: No Wasted Catch
noWaste.description: Reduces discard mortality and makes the most of by‑catch.

pembeli.title: For Buyers
pembeli.subtitle: Steady supply, transparent prices
pembeli.imageAlt: An industrial processing facility on a riverbank

supply.title: Consistent Supply
supply.description: More stable animal-based raw material for downstream industry.

pricing.title: Transparent Pricing
pricing.description: Choose by freshness grade and the nearest location.

sdgs.title: Together for a Better Future
sdgs.subtitle: ByCatch Loop supports 5 Sustainable Development Goals that align with our mission.

14.title: Life Below Water
14.description: Reduces discard mortality by giving by‑catch economic value, while recording non‑target catch volumes.

12.title: Responsible Consumption & Production
12.description: Turns biomass that would be thrown away into feed and fertilizer raw material (waste valorization).

2.title: Zero Hunger
2.description: Small-scale fishers earn extra income from catch that used to have no value.

8.title: Decent Work & Economic Growth
8.description: Helps downstream small businesses (maggot farmers, silage and fertilizer makers) get a steady supply.

13.title: Climate Action
13.description: Estimates the methane emissions avoided from marine biomass rotting on the coast.

footer.tagline: Connecting fishers with downstream industry for a better future for our seas.
